name: identity
title: Identity verification
summary: Verify a user's identity through Persona or manual staff review of an ID photo and selfie, and show verification badges: official, organization and notable (reviewed applications with evidence and DNS domain proofs) and a paid badge an entitlement grants.

env.name: PERSONA_API_KEY
env.doc: Persona API key. Set → Persona hosted verification; empty → manual review by staff.
env.source: Persona dashboard → API → API keys (use the sandbox key outside production)

env.name: PERSONA_TEMPLATE_ID
env.doc: Inquiry template id (itmpl_…) new inquiries use. Required when PERSONA_API_KEY is set.

env.name: PERSONA_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.doc: Signing secret of the Persona webhook pointed at /webhooks/persona. Required when PERSONA_API_KEY is set.
env.source: Persona dashboard → Webhooks → your endpoint (events: inquiry.completed, approved, declined, failed, expired, marked-for-review)

env.name: PERSONA_ENVIRONMENT_ID
env.doc: Persona environment id (env_…) passed to the hosted flow and to clients for the embedded flow.

env.name: IDENTITY_MAX_ATTEMPTS
env.doc: Rejected attempts before a user must contact support to verify.

env.name: IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_TTL
env.doc: How long a verification lasts, as a Go duration (8760h = a year). 0 never expires.

env.name: IDENTITY_BADGE_LABELS
env.doc: Names of the badge kinds, kind=Label pairs over the defaults (e.g. paid=Patron). Up to 40 characters each.

env.name: IDENTITY_BADGE_CATEGORIES
env.doc: What people apply for, key:kind:Label entries; kind is org or notable (the badge an approval grants). Empty turns applications off.

env.name: IDENTITY_BADGE_TTL_DAYS
env.doc: Days an approved organization or notable badge lasts before the holder applies again (1 to 730); reviewers can pick another.

env.name: IDENTITY_PAID_ENTITLEMENT
env.doc: The payments entitlement key whose holders get the paid badge (stitching wires payments to identity.SetPaidBadge).

env.name: IDENTITY_PAID_MIN_ACCOUNT_DAYS
env.doc: Account age in days before the paid badge shows (0 in development by default).

env.name: IDENTITY_PAID_REQUIRES_VERIFIED
env.doc: Show the paid badge only to people who verified their identity.

stitch: Decide what requires verification and gate it with identity.IsVerified (return identity.ErrVerificationRequired).
Show badges where people judge each other (profiles, listings, messages): VerifiedBadge (web and mobile) with userId, or with badge/verified from identity.BadgeSet and identity.VerifiedSet on lists.
Persona: create a template, point a webhook at https://<api>/webhooks/persona, set the 4 PERSONA_* variables, and name Persona in the privacy policy.
Manual mode: staff the admin queue; photos are deleted as soon as a decision is made.
Allow the hosted-flow return: web origins come from CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS/PUBLIC_WEB_URL, mobile uses scaffoldapp://.

Badges: set IDENTITY_BADGE_CATEGORIES to what your community verifies (or empty to turn applications off) and IDENTITY_BADGE_LABELS to your names; staff work Admin → Verification → Badge applications; admins grant official badges.

Paid badge with payments installed: add backend/internal/api/stitch_identity_payments.go from FEATURE.md (entitlement hook → identity.SetPaidBadge, stop renewal on staff removal, eligibility guard on checkout), create a plan that grants IDENTITY_PAID_ENTITLEMENT, and call setIdentityPaidBadgeLink at startup on web and mobile.
With notifications installed, register kinds identity.status and identity.badge.
